name: MAMTA SINGH SENGAR
title: ==QUALITY ASSURANCE ENGINEER — REMOTE==  ·  MANUAL & AUTOMATION TESTING

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: QA engineer with **4.8 years of experience** in manual and automation testing for client applications. Collaborated with developers, executed regression suites, and reported defects across web/mobile and enterprise products. Proven ability to **work independently** — led test planning and execution as Senior QA and delivered a self-driven upskilling program during a career break.
